{{Top|leg}}
A '''Claimer''' was a title held by a group of servants of the [[Odionate]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Sith Wars]]. These individuals searched for people that had embraced the end and nothingness, and no longer cared whether they lived of [[Death/Legends|died]], just like their master, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]]. The Claimers watched for such individuals even within enemy territory, to find those that wanted to end their lives on their own terms. Thus, Claimers looked for such people that embraced death as their answer, then brought them into the service of Odion.

In the New Sith Wars, [[Wayman]] was a Claimer who traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tergamenion]] that belonged to the Sith [[Daiman]], where the Claimer dressed as a [[Sith trooper (New Sith Wars)|Sith trooper]]. He moved to save the life of a [[Daimanate]] citizen who was actually [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kerra Holt]] in disguise. Wayman attempted to sway the disguised Holt into the service of Odion and departed the scene.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Claimers appeared in the [[Star Wars: Knight Errant: Escape|''Escape'']] arc of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series [[Star Wars: Knight Errant (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knight Errant'']], by [[John Jackson Miller]]. According to Miller, the Claimers served in a similar role to the [[Wikipedia:Valkyrie|valkyries]] of [[Wikipedia:Norse mythology|Norse mythology]].<ref name="Insider 133">{{InsiderCite|133|Blaster}}</ref>
